newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine 2-year note coupon rate rises to 12 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine 2-year note coupon rate rises to 12 pct.

text.p: The yield on the Philippine two-year treasury note rose to 12 percent from the previous month's 11.50, the Bureau of Treasury said on Tuesday.
The auction committee awarded four billion pesos out of the 13.56 billion pesos worth of bids tendered by financial institutions.
Accepted bids ranged from 11.6 to 12.0 percent.
Traders were expecting the coupon to rise following a series of rate increases undertaken by the Central Bank in recent weeks to curb peso speculation.
The two-year fixed rate Treasury bonds are auctioned every month. -- MANILA NEWSROOM (63 2) 841-8938 Fax 817-6267
